notes.title: Heads up: Cosmic Ray will soon be free!
notes.content: Hey there, in an effort to find more players for some of my older games, I've decided to make Cosmic Ray free! As per Valve policy, I'm providing one month's notice before the making the change. You can expect the change in early June.

notes.title: Artifact Update now live!
notes.content:
The Artifact Update is now live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226792/71cfd4e202f1400266bdfe04bce409f6e3f7fa79.png[/img]

[*]Added trails for asteroids
[*]Orbit lines are now dashed instead of solid
[*]Improved ship part, artifact and blueprint pickup effect (leave particle system)
[*]Revamped explosive mines, explosion particles
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226792/ae90492de29e394be0be19ad17b369648ac13fb9.png[/img]

Late game enemy ships now drop explosive mines. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33226792/b93c95eb5c5acd33c9b1dab55e6d0f9aa3869b44.gif[/img]

[*]Fix for enemies not taking damage from asteroids

[/list]

notes.title: Introducing: Super Rocket Ride!
notes.content:
I'm pleased to announce my latest game, Super Rocket Ride!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020503/e21ef2a2663609cb12948c92a7f49206d6e21789.png[/img]

It can best be described as a cross between old school lander games and classic platformers of the SNES era: a simple control scheme, lush pixel art, and unforgiving levels fraught with obstacles and hazards.

Super Rocket Ride is being developed in collaboration with Unruly Games.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UYiYXqGusUs
[b]Features[/b]
🚀 24 hand-crafted levels (with more on the way)
🚀 Analog controls
🚀 Over-the-top physics-based deaths
🚀 Contemporary atmospheric soundtrack featuring music from Snug, JFS and Ogotu

The game will be hitting Steam in the next few months. If you're interested in checking it out ahead of that, we're running [url=https://cosmocat.itch.io/super-rocket-ride]early access on Itch[/url] for the next little while.

We're also offering [url=https://dodistribute.com/access/1FfsnuogYx/]advance copies[/url] for streamers, reviewers, and curators. All we ask is that you reflect the early access status in your coverage, and update it when the game releases in full.

Last but not least, don't forget to join the official [url=http://cosmocatgames.com/discord/]Cosmocat Discord[/url] to stay up to date about my games and chat with other players about the things that matter in life (mostly: games, beer, cats and music).

notes.title: Build 20
notes.content:
Build 20 is now live and includes the following:

[h1]New enemy type![/h1]
Insanely creative working name: "space blob". These guys build up energy as you shoot them, which charges up their deflection attack. Eventually they totally discharge and "rest" for a while.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33226792/4b12388668e642acd2dc73d32b3315efd4bee17f.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33226792/691470bc5c8982c1ea99e553ebca51bb32828f64.gif[/img]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Enemy ship fire patterns: rather than firing continuously, there are now gaps. This makes evasion a little bit easier/predictable.
[*] New main laser SFX: less "piercing" sound, with some variations (you can still toggle between other SFX using up/down on keyboard or D-pad, but there is no variation in these).
[*] Fire rate limit: previously it was possible to spam the fire button (i.e. using a macro) to exceed the intended repeat rate.
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing: Brainmelter Deluxe!
notes.content:
Adam from Cosmocat here. I'm happy to announce our newest game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/964060/Brainmelter_Deluxe/]Brainmelter Deluxe[/url]!

Brainmelter Deluxe is a challenging, reflex-based platform game with a (literal) twist: the level rotates 90 degrees when you jump.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020503/c26ba16efd70fb19969b24c161aae876ab565f86.gif[/img]

[h1]Game Features[/h1]
🧠 procedurally generated levels mean no two runs are exactly the same
🧠 beautifully hand illustrated cutscenes
🧠 over-the-top physics-based deaths
🧠 lush retro-inspired graphics, contemporized with modern dynamic lighting and particle effects
🧠 a silky smooth funk and instrumental hip-hop soundtrack to help ease your saltiness

[h1]Who is this game for?[/h1]
Brainmelter Deluxe's randomized levels and permadeath system mean it's best suited to those looking for a challenging experience; one which requires mastery of the mechanic, and lightning-fast reflexes. 

We hope you like it!

notes.title: Build 16
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm happy to announce the first official patch for Cosmic Ray! This build adds several bug fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*]fix for hidden mouse cursor interacting with menus when using gamepad
[*]fix for SFX playing on interaction with disabled buttons
[*]fix to only center mouse cursor if using gamepad (otherwise, use mouse position)
[*]fix for some physics updates bound to framerate
[*]improve mouse/gamepad button interaction (it should no longer be possible to get into a state where NO button is selected)
[*]hide mouse cursor on D-pad input
[*]pulse hull integrity on health pickup
[/list]

notes.title: Hello worlds
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020503/63b65772ed85eb9b83c28eb9abdb5db8246cd245.png[/img]

Hey guys, Adam from Cosmocat here. I'm excited to announce our newest game: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/894740/Cosmic_Ray/]Cosmic Ray[/url]!

Cosmic Ray is a game about exploring space in search of hospitable planets for colonization. It's pretty easy to pick up--dare I say casual--and features fairly short rounds, so we think it's a good option for killing a few minutes.

Despite the simplicity we try to keep things challenging and interesting with permadeath, randomized galaxies, ship upgrades and alien artifacts to be found with each run.

We're hoping to launch next month. In the meantime, feel free to follow along with the progress on our [url=https://forums.tigsource.com/index.php?topic=65256.0]devlog.[/url]

Last but not least, we have a [url=http://cosmocatgames.com/discord/]Discord[/url]! Stop in and say hello, learn more about our previous games, and our upcoming closed beta for Cosmic Ray.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33020503/e0c273709a8ff8abe1e98a1524619b61b1f92900.png[/img]
